language.label: Harshe
home.hero.title: Dokokin tarayya, a sauƙaƙe.
home.hero.subtitle: Duk wani kuduri da yake gaban Majalisar Dattawa, Majalisar Wakilai, da majalisun jihohi — muna binsa daga karatu na farko har zuwa amincewa, kuma muna fassara shi daga yaren shari'a zuwa Turanci mai sauƙi.
home.hero.search_placeholder: Nemi kuduri — gwada "kuɗin wuta" ko "hutun haihuwa"
home.recent.title: Sabbin abubuwan da suka faru
home.recent.subtitle: Kudurorin da suka ƙaura kwanan nan a duk majalisu.
home.topics.title: Bincika ta hanyar batutuwa
home.topics.subtitle: Abin da ƙasar ke tattaunawa yanzu.
home.chambers.title: Ta majalisa
home.chambers.subtitle: Majalisar Tarayya da majalisun jihohi da muke rufe yanzu.
home.stages.title: Inda kudurori suke a yanzu
home.stages.subtitle: Hoton duk kuduri a cikin database namu, an raba shi ta inda yake a tsarin.
home.contribute.title: Ka ga kuduri da ba mu ba?
home.contribute.subtitle: Taimaka mana cike gibin. Aika kuduri daga majalisar jihar ka. Edita zai tabbatar da tushen kafin bugawa.
bills.title: Bincika kudurori
bills.empty: Babu kuduri da ya dace da matattara.
bill.explainer.subtitle: Taƙaitaccen bayani ba na ɓangare ba, wanda AI ya tsara kuma editoci suka duba don kudurori masu mahimmanci.
bill.explainer.translated_from: AI ne ya fassara shi daga Turanci.
footer.tagline: Tsarin jama'a kyauta, ba na ɓangare ba. Muna bin kudurori a duk majalisun Najeriya, muna fassara su zuwa Turanci mai sauƙi don kowane ɗan ƙasa ya iya bin aikin da ake yi a sunansa.
footer.notice: AI ne ya tsara taƙaitattun bayanai, editoci kuma sun duba don kudurori masu mahimmanci
